label: Gmail
description: Read, search, and inspect email threads in a Gmail mailbox via the Gmail REST API.
notes: Send/reply/draft/approval actions are not transpiled: Gmail's messages.send and drafts.create endpoints only accept a base64url-encoded RFC 822 MIME message, which the piece builds with MailComposer (plus attachment handling, thread lookups, and pause/resume for approvals) — not expressible in static HTTP templating. gmail.getEmail simplifies the piece's get-mail action: instead of fetching format=raw and MIME-parsing with mailparser, it requests the API's structured full/metadata/minimal formats. gmail.searchEmails is the underlying single messages.list call with a free-form query field replacing the piece's structured filter props (from/to/subject/label/dates map 1:1 onto Gmail query syntax); the boolean includeSpamTrash param was dropped since an always-present empty value is not tolerated, and the piece's per-result hydration (raw GET + MIME parse per message) needs the piece runtime. gmail.getThread comes from get-thread-action.ts, which is a pure single GET (present in the piece source though not registered in its index.ts). Service-account auth (JWT signing) is not expressible; nodes use a plain OAuth2 access token. The piece's generic custom-API-call action was skipped as non-specific.

nodes.label: Gmail: Get Email
nodes.description: Fetch a single Gmail message by ID, returning its headers, labels, and snippet.
nodes.search: gmail google mail email message get read fetch inbox by id

config.label: Message ID
config.help: Gmail message ID, e.g. from a search node or trigger output

config.label: Format
config.help: full returns the complete payload; metadata returns headers only; minimal returns IDs and labels

credentials.help: OAuth2 access token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly scope

config.help: full returns complete message payloads; metadata returns headers only; minimal returns IDs and labels
